title: Adversarial Patch Detection for YOLO
description: Object detectors like YOLO can be tricked by a printed patch placed in the scene, causing objects to disappear or be mislabelled. Our research builds a runtime monitoring layer around Ultralytics YOLO that watches the model's behaviour during inference and flags frames that look like they contain an adversarial patch, without retraining the detector itself.

title: Programmable trust for funding
description: I'm interested in replacing trust in middlemen with verifiable code: milestone based escrow, token weighted governance, and automatic revenue sharing. Building ForgeCapita taught me how much of a financial product can live on-chain, and where off-chain services, indexers and gasless relayers still need to fill the gaps.
